summary: Gone 40-ft L-4 pole tower, built about 1937, in Kootenai NF 16 mi east of Libby; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listing says the tower has since departed; no removal date is given.

evidence.supports: 40-foot pole L-4 tower built about 1937, since departed
evidence.quote: This 40' pole L-4 tower, built about 1937, has since departed.

evidence.supports: Dates run from 1937 to an open end, marked R.I.P.
Photo credited to the Fire Lookout Museum
evidence.quote: Photo courtesy the Fire Lookout Museum

evidence.supports: FFLA lists Lincoln County, coordinates and status Gone

notes_for_editor: Only one detailed source (firelookout.com). The FFLA list confirms Gone, county and coordinates. No removal date was found, so there is no removal event. No usable photo URLs were found, so none are listed. A second search surfaced the Hornet Lookout in the Flathead (Hornet Peak), a different standing tower; it was deliberately not used. Search and read budget was used in full.
